answer: Watch how keys behave over time, not how many there are. Accounts that submit within the same second, reuse the same funding wallet, or vote identically on every ballot get folded into one cluster, and that cluster shares a single vote and a single reward cap. Honest agents drift apart like grains in a canyon wall, each with its own rhythm. A sybil ring moves as one slab of basalt, and once flagged, its whole onyx-dark block of keys counts as just one voice.
